retired.fix_commit_subject: zle: port the SIGWINCH redraw, printfmt's % escapes + erase-to-EOL, M-t's NUL-terminator read, and insert_positions' second cline_str walk
retired.why: zle: … item 3 — printfmt's tail (zle_tricky.c:2576-2588) and its newline branch (c:2539-2549) had neither the TCCLEAREOL nor the space-padding fallback, and the per-character wrap-column `" \010"` (c:2571-2572) was missing too.
retired.evidence: re-verified first-hand by scripts/compsys_regressions.py under --variants: the fixture cell scored NOW-PASSES -> NOW-PASSES -> NOW-PASSES, and every variant and control of it came back NOW-PASSES. The runner reported the binary MOVED since the stamp (6420c23cecc13c35 -> 723088f811cdd366), which is the 'somebody fixed the bug' branch of the two the README names, not the 'the fixture was wrong' one.
retired.kept_because: a fixed bug is worth more as a guard than as a deleted file: the cell stays in the evidence base and the gate now FAILS if the divergence comes back.

guard_verified.against: /opt/homebrew/bin/zshrs -> Cellar/zshrs-all/0.12.49/bin/zshrs, the Homebrew-installed RELEASE build of the same version, 18273880 bytes, sha256 fb94500d8e1c32e7, built 2026-08-30 06:20:45 — before d555917f07 (08:04) and 44a3b4841c (08:32), so it still carries the bug
guard_verified.note: the flip is only worth something if the gate would CATCH the bug coming back, so it was pointed at a build that still has it: `compsys_regressions.py --zshrs /opt/homebrew/bin/zshrs --only listing_row_erase_to_eol`. It reported CONTROL-MOVED and exited 1. The harness detail it produced there is the same one observed_when_diverging records, so the guard fails on THIS bug and not merely on some difference.

observed.measured: 2026-08-30, commit 44a3b4841c, a byte-identical copy of target/debug/zshrs, passed with --zshrs (zshrs 0.12.49, 101620888 bytes, sha256 723088f811cdd366) vs zsh 5.9.2 (aarch64-apple-darwin25.4.0)
observed.notes: the raw escape streams agree under `--strict-stream` — the mode that found this in the first place, since both grids always rendered identically. zshrs now emits the erase-to-EOL after each listing row as zsh does.

observed_when_diverging.notes: Both grids render identically, so only --strict-stream sees it. zsh terminates each listing row with an erase-to-end-of-line; zshrs writes the row and stops. Visible on a terminal only when the row overwrites longer stale text.
observed_when_diverging.recorded_under: commit 3b4a01f0cd, target/debug/zshrs zshrs 0.12.49 (101601256 bytes, 2026-08-30 05:50:47), zsh 5.9.2 (aarch64-apple-darwin25.4.0) — this is the divergence AS MEASURED BEFORE 44a3b4841c. It is history, not current behaviour; the fixture now asserts the two shells AGREE.

variants.note: WHEN THIS FIXTURE DIVERGED: second witness, confirmed 2026-08-30: a zero-match listing (a _message plus an empty compadd group). Same shape: zsh emits \e[K after 'no matches here, only a message' and after 'a message for an empty group'; zshrs emits neither.  NOW: agrees (NOW-PASSES -> NOW-PASSES -> NOW-PASSES; harness detail 'PASS').

spec.completer:
#compdef fzcc

local expl
_message -r 'no matches here, only a message'
compadd -J g -x 'a message for an empty group' -U -Q -E 2 --
